cardInfo.name: AD-PIN-120 · direct, exact pin
cardInfo.summary: DIRECT ADOPTION, EXACT PIN, and pinned BELOW what any app resolves. The three apps sit on 1.3.0 and 2.1.0; this instance names records@1.2.0 in its own meta.adoptsFrom and cannot be moved by any of them. It still draws the pre-house-style invoice, which is what a frozen pin looks like from the outside.
